title: Orthogonal projection onto a closed Hilbert subspace
statement: Over the real field $\mathbf R$ [def-weil-field], let $V$ be a real inner product space complete for its inner product norm, and let $R\subseteq V$ be a real linear subspace closed in the norm topology. Define $R^\perp=\{h\in V:\langle r,h\rangle=0\text{ for all }r\in R\}$. For every $a\in V$ there exist $r\in R$ and $h\in R^\perp$ such that $a=r+h$.
